verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI returns result.markdown directly from a single arun call, and also via the CLI with '-o markdown'. It adds Fit Markdown and BM25 noise filtering for AI-ready text, and it handles rendering through JS execution, full-page scrolling and iframe extraction. Blocking is addressed with undetected/stealth browsers, proxy rotation and retry fallbacks, and a community user says it 'solves many LLM-scraping headaches'. Other community comments note that users still own bot mitigation and quality gates in production. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence of output cleanliness or anti-bot success rates, and anti-blocking that works without user-supplied proxies or configuration.
